title: Dogs that chew shirts
summary: Chat about his two dogs, one that runs off and one that chews shirts off the line.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: Hmm. Well, you have two dogs, huh?

You've got one dog that runs away and just comes home at night to eat and the other one chews your shirts off the line. Chews my shirts off. You said the dog chewed another one of his shirts off and he'd better whip him again.
I didn't want to put the rose on this season. Then he didn't give him nothing either. That's the nice thing.
Oh, then he's going to eat your shirts some more and he's going to be hungry. You know, eat that wood out there.
What happened to all those cases of dog food you bought him? You built him a dog house? Yeah.
You know you've got a good house. You eat before I eat in the morning.
You stuff some way to keep them away.
The puppet has bit me already, man.
